note: Chapter -> CCSS-M codes, mapped by WHAT THE CHAPTER TEACHES, never by grade number. Propel runs ahead of CCSS in places (Class 5 sets profit & loss, which CCSS places in grade 7), so grade numbers deliberately do not line up.

chapters.name: Sharpening Pre-number Skills
chapters.rationale: Comparing length/weight and describing position are the pre-number skills this chapter drills.

chapters.name: Numbers (0 to 9)
chapters.rationale: Counting, writing and comparing the numerals 0-9.

chapters.name: Addition and Subtraction (0 to 9)
chapters.rationale: Adding and subtracting within 10, including word problems.

chapters.name: Numbers (up to 50)
chapters.rationale: Counting, reading and writing numerals past 20.

chapters.name: Addition and Subtraction of Numbers (up to 50)
chapters.rationale: Two-digit addition and subtraction within 100.

chapters.name: Numbers (up to 100)
chapters.rationale: Numbers to 100 and the tens-and-ones idea behind them.

chapters.name: Addition and Subtraction of Numbers (up to 100)
chapters.rationale: Two-digit addition and subtraction within 100.

chapters.name: Introduction to Multiplication
chapters.rationale: Skip counting and repeated addition, which is how multiplication is introduced here.

chapters.name: Geometrical Shapes and Patterns
chapters.rationale: Naming plane and solid shapes by their attributes and building with them.

chapters.name: Measurements
chapters.rationale: Comparing and ordering by length using non-standard units.

chapters.name: Time and Calendar
chapters.rationale: Telling time to the hour and half hour.

chapters.name: Money
chapters.rationale: Indian coins and notes. The only CCSS money standard names dollar bills, quarters, dimes, nickels and pennies, so it is deliberately NOT mapped — a rupee chapter must not inherit American currency wording.

chapters.name: Data Handling
chapters.rationale: Sorting objects into categories and counting how many in each.

chapters.name: 2-Digit Numbers
chapters.rationale: Place value in two-digit numbers, plus odd and even.

chapters.name: 3-Digit Numbers
chapters.rationale: Hundreds place value, expanded form and comparing three-digit numbers.

chapters.name: Addition of 2- and 3-Digit Numbers
chapters.rationale: Adding within 1000 with and without regrouping.

chapters.name: Subtraction of 2- and 3-digit Numbers
chapters.rationale: Subtracting within 1000 with and without regrouping.

chapters.name: Multiplication
chapters.rationale: Repeated addition into multiplication facts and multiplying by a one-digit number.

chapters.name: Introduction to Division
chapters.rationale: Division as equal sharing and as the inverse of multiplication.

chapters.name: Geometrical Shapes
chapters.rationale: Recognising and drawing shapes by their attributes.

chapters.name: Fractions
chapters.rationale: Halves, quarters and three-fourths as equal shares of a whole.

chapters.name: Measurement
chapters.rationale: Measuring with standard units and estimating lengths.

chapters.name: Time
chapters.rationale: Telling time to five minutes, including quarter past and quarter to.

chapters.name: Money
chapters.rationale: Indian coins and notes. The only CCSS money standard names dollar bills, quarters, dimes, nickels and pennies, so it is deliberately NOT mapped — a rupee chapter must not inherit American currency wording.

chapters.name: Data Handling
chapters.rationale: Drawing and reading picture graphs and bar graphs.

chapters.name: Numbers
chapters.rationale: Four-digit numbers and comparison. Roman numerals have no CCSS counterpart and are not mapped.

chapters.name: Addition
chapters.rationale: Column addition of three- and four-digit numbers.

chapters.name: Subtraction
chapters.rationale: Subtraction with regrouping and estimating by rounding.

chapters.name: Multiplication
chapters.rationale: Multiplication facts, fluency, and multiplying by multiples of ten.

chapters.name: Division
chapters.rationale: Division as equal sharing, its link to multiplication, and fact fluency.

chapters.name: Fractions
chapters.rationale: A fraction as parts of a whole, with numerator and denominator named.

chapters.name: Geometry
chapters.rationale: Classifying plane and solid figures, and lines of symmetry.

chapters.name: Patterns
chapters.rationale: Spotting and continuing arithmetic patterns.

chapters.name: Measurement
chapters.rationale: Standard units of mass and capacity, and converting between them.

chapters.name: Time
chapters.rationale: Telling time to the minute and finding elapsed time.

chapters.name: Money
chapters.rationale: Money word problems using the four operations; the rupee/paise conversion itself is not in CCSS.

chapters.name: Data Handling
chapters.rationale: Tally marks, tables and pictographs.

chapters.rationale: Place value, expanded notation and rounding. The Indian place value system (lakh, crore) has no CCSS counterpart.

chapters.rationale: Standard algorithm for multi-digit addition and subtraction.

chapters.name: Multiplication
chapters.rationale: Multi-digit multiplication and estimating products.

chapters.name: Division
chapters.rationale: Dividing four-digit numbers and testing divisibility.

chapters.name: Measurement
chapters.rationale: Converting units within a system and solving measurement problems.

chapters.name: Perimeter and Area
chapters.rationale: Area and perimeter of rectangles and of irregular figures.

chapters.rationale: Elapsed time and time word problems. The 24-hour clock is not separately in CCSS.

chapters.name: Money
chapters.rationale: Money problems using the four operations.

chapters.name: Data Handling
chapters.rationale: Tables, pictographs and reading bar graphs.

chapters.name: Introduction to Decimals
chapters.rationale: Decimal notation for fractions, and comparing decimals.

chapters.name: Large Numbers
chapters.rationale: Place value and rounding at scale. The Indian system (lakh, crore) has no CCSS counterpart.

chapters.name: Addition and Subtraction
chapters.rationale: Standard algorithm carried to larger numbers.

chapters.name: Multiplication
chapters.rationale: Fluent multi-digit multiplication.

chapters.name: Division
chapters.rationale: Dividing by two- and three-digit divisors.

chapters.rationale: Order of operations (DMAS) and the unitary method, which is proportional reasoning.

chapters.name: Multiples and Factors
chapters.rationale: Prime factorisation and common factors and multiples.

chapters.name: Fractions
chapters.rationale: Like and unlike fractions, comparison, and adding and subtracting them.

chapters.name: Decimals and Percentages
chapters.rationale: Reading and operating on decimals; percentage is proportional reasoning.

chapters.name: Shapes and Figures
chapters.rationale: Measuring angles with a protractor and classifying triangles and quadrilaterals.

chapters.name: Measurement and Temperature
chapters.rationale: Converting metric units. Celsius/Fahrenheit is not separately in CCSS.

chapters.name: Perimeter, Area and Volume
chapters.rationale: Volume of cubes and cuboids, and area of triangles and irregular figures.

chapters.name: Time
chapters.rationale: Time word problems; the 24-hour clock has no separate CCSS standard.

chapters.name: Money
chapters.rationale: Cost price, selling price, profit and loss are percent problems — CCSS places them in grade 7.

chapters.name: Data Handling
chapters.rationale: Bar graphs, and organising data for display. Pie and line graphs have no CCSS counterpart at this level.

chapters.name: Patterns in Mathematics
chapters.rationale: Generating and describing number and shape patterns.

chapters.name: Lines and Angles
chapters.rationale: Points, lines, rays and angles, and measuring them.

chapters.name: Playing with Large Numbers
chapters.rationale: Large-number place value, order of operations and approximation.

chapters.name: Data Handling and Presentation
chapters.rationale: Collecting, organising and displaying data.

chapters.name: Factors and Multiples
chapters.rationale: HCF, LCM and prime factorisation.

chapters.name: Perimeter and Area
chapters.rationale: Area and perimeter of plane figures.

chapters.name: Fractions
chapters.rationale: Equivalent fractions, lowest terms, comparison, and adding and subtracting.

chapters.name: Playing with Constructions
chapters.rationale: Compass-and-straightedge construction has no CCSS standard below high school; only the shape properties map.

chapters.name: Symmetry
chapters.rationale: Lines of symmetry, reflection and rotational symmetry.

chapters.name: Integers
chapters.rationale: Negative numbers, the number line, and comparing integers.

chapters.name: Large Numbers around Us
chapters.rationale: Place value at scale and approximation.

chapters.name: Arithmetic Expressions
chapters.rationale: Evaluating expressions and removing brackets.

chapters.name: Decimals
chapters.rationale: Decimal place value to thousandths, comparison, and adding and subtracting.

chapters.name: Expressions Using Letter-Numbers
chapters.rationale: Writing, reading and evaluating algebraic expressions with variables.

chapters.name: Parallel and Intersecting Lines
chapters.rationale: Angle pairs, and angles formed by a transversal with parallel lines.

chapters.name: Patterns in Mathematics
chapters.rationale: Parity, grid sums and number patterns. Magic squares have no CCSS counterpart.

chapters.name: Triangle and its Properties
chapters.rationale: Triangle properties, the angle sum, and constructing triangles.

chapters.name: Working with Fractions
chapters.rationale: Multiplying fractions and dividing by a fraction using the reciprocal.

chapters.name: Geometric Twins
chapters.rationale: Congruence, tested by superposition.

chapters.name: Operations with Integers
chapters.rationale: Adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing integers.

chapters.name: Finding Common Ground
chapters.rationale: HCF and LCM and their applications.

chapters.name: Another Peek beyond the Point
chapters.rationale: Multiplying and dividing decimals.

chapters.name: Connecting the Dots
chapters.rationale: Measures of central tendency and bar graphs.

chapters.name: Constructions and Tilings
chapters.rationale: Geometric construction; bisectors and tiling have no direct CCSS standard below high school.

chapters.name: Finding the Unknown
chapters.rationale: Framing and solving simple equations.

chapters.name: A Square and a Cube
chapters.rationale: Square and cube roots of perfect squares and cubes.

chapters.name: Power Play
chapters.rationale: Laws of exponents, negative exponents and powers of ten.

chapters.name: A Story of Numbers
chapters.rationale: History of number systems. No CCSS standard covers this; left unmapped on purpose.

chapters.name: Quadrilaterals
chapters.rationale: Classifying quadrilaterals by their properties, and constructing them.

chapters.name: Number Play
chapters.rationale: Parity, divisibility and number patterns. Cryptarithms have no CCSS counterpart.

chapters.name: We Distribute, yet Things Multiply
chapters.rationale: Multiplying algebraic expressions using the distributive property, and identities.

chapters.name: Proportional Reasoning — I
chapters.rationale: Ratio, sharing in a ratio, proportion and unit conversion.

chapters.name: Rational Numbers
chapters.rationale: Operations on rational numbers and their decimal expansions.

chapters.name: Factorisation
chapters.rationale: Factoring algebraic expressions and dividing them.

chapters.name: Mensuration
chapters.rationale: Area of composite shapes, surface area from nets, and volume.

chapters.name: Data Handling
chapters.rationale: Grouping data and displaying it.

chapters.name: Percentage and Its Applications
chapters.rationale: Profit, loss, discount, tax and interest are all multistep percent problems.

chapters.name: Proportional Reasoning — II
chapters.rationale: Direct and inverse variation as proportional relationships.

chapters.name: Linear Equations in One Variable
chapters.rationale: Solving and applying linear equations in one variable.
